It can be made by using an augmentor on a Staff of Sliske (blood), or by using blood dye on an augmented Staff of Sliske.
The Aurora Longsword is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 2 of the Wintumber Aurora Yak Track with the premier pass.
Beach Sandy Maul is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override unlocked by redeeming a sandy maul override token.

Black gold-trimmed armour set (sk).x: Black gold-trimmed armour set (sk) is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

Blood Soul Witch token.x: Blood Soul Witch token is a token that unlocks the Blood Soul Witch Outfit cosmetic override when redeemed, destroying the token after a confirmation prompt. The token could originally be received from opening Large Forgotten Belongings during the Parcels from the Dead event in 2025.

Captain Deathbeard is a cosmetic override outfit override awarded by completion of the Deathbeard's Demise seasonal event.
The entire outfit could be won from the Event mystery boxes of the Shifting Sands event.

A chipped black stone crystal can be obtained as a very rare drop from Seiryu the Azure Serpent.
Despite being a one-off drop, a duplicate chipped black stone crystal can be obtained from a doubled drop.
Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.

Deathspore arrows are tier 95 arrows, obtained by attaching deathspore arrow tips to elder headless shafts.

When 12 stacks of Feasting Spores are obtained, they are consumed to grant a 9-second (15 ticks) buff that makes the next Ranged ability that would cost adrenaline free; this includes special attacks.

Dervish skirt (blue).x: The blue dervish skirt is part of the dervish outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Discarded sword hilt.x: Discarded sword hilt is an item used in the 2021 Halloween event. It can be found using Luna's compass around Draynor Manor. It is brought to Greg alongside the discarded sword blade to create Arteria.

The explorer's ring 2 is a reward from the easy Lumbridge achievements.
The ring is received from Bob in Lumbridge.
If a higher tier explorer's ring has been obtained, explorer's ring 2 cannot be retrieved for free.
It can also be re-obtained at May's Quest Caravan after putting 150 quest points into the Hub Track.

Falador shield 3.x: The Falador shield 3, also called the Tower shield, is a reward for completing the easy, medium and Hard Falador achievements. Players may obtain the shield from the Squire Asrol in the White Knights' Castle. If you have lost the shield, speaking to the squire will allow you to obtain a new one.

Fatebound Champion Mask.x: The Fatebound Champion Mask is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Fatebound Champion Armour set.

The game book, titled Party Pete's Bumper Book of Games, is found on the bookshelves in Player-owned houses.
Ghul Invoker Regalia is a cosmetic override outfit that is unlocked through the Soul Showdown promotion from Treasure Hunter.
The gold diamond key is a key found in Daemonheim while training the Dungeoneering skill.
Only one gold diamond key can be found in a single dungeon.
It is made by first smithing a gold bowl from 2 gold bars, granting 30 Smithing experience, having Gujuo bless it, and then using it on a water source.

Hellfire Blade.x: Hellfire Blade is a main-hand Melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Hellfire Weapon Bundle or the Hellfire Mega Bundle.

sc: It is obtained by killing 900 abyssal demons while wearing the mask.
It is given to the player by Sigli the Huntsman in order to track down an otherwise invisible spirit called the Draugen.

If the player uses the drop trick to obtain multiple talismans (that do not contain the Draugen's spirit), if they select locate after gaining Sigli's vote, all talismans that do not contain the Draugen's spirit will vanish from the player's inventory.
The Inverted Herblore skillcape token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that reach level 99 Herblore during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
Iron sickles can be purchased from Gardener Gunnhild on the island of Miscellania for 15 coins each.
It is created by poisoning a iron spear with poison karambwan paste, and can be given to Tamayu so that he can attempt to defeat the Shaikahan.
After completing Tai Bwo Wannai Trio, kp poisoned spears can be bought from Tamayu's Spear Stall.

A large bright star is an item that can be won from Treasure Hunter.
The matching right boot can be obtained by using Telekinetic Grab through the north window.
Once the player has obtained both boots, they automatically turn into exquisite boots and can be delivered to Riki the sculptor's model.
A longbow sight is an item bought from Daemonheim Rewards in Daemonheim for 10,000 Dungeoneering tokens while having level 45 Ranged and Dungeoneering.
The Lucille token is a token can be redeemed to unlock the Lucille pet, destroying the token in the process after a confirmation prompt.

Monkfish can be caught in the Piscatoris Fishing Colony with a small fishing net; accessing the colony requires players to have completed Swan Song.
Musketeer is a cosmetic override outfit that can be purchased from Solomon's General Store.
It was first available as an item set through the Members Loyalty Programme.

Necturion (Masterwork) Platebody.x: The Necturion (Masterwork) Platebody is a torso slot cosmetic override that is part of the Necturion (Masterwork) Outfit. Along with the rest of the outfit, it can be unlocked by spending 100% respect in the Artisans' Workshop.

sc: The novite warhammer is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
Observation: Revelry is a memory found in JasKra's chamber during Heart of Stone.
The pack can't be obtained in item form by players.
Petruccio's feather is an item found in a barricade in the Nodon Front in Senntisten.

The feather can be found on a crate near Valluta and a Zarosian helmet on the floor, which can be reached by leaving the cathedral through the west door, walking down the stairs and turning north near Nex and past the Abyssal Knights.
Red flowers are also a possible reward from Soul Wars gambling.
Refined daeyalt is an item obtained during the River of Blood quest from the refined daeyalt mine at Castle Drakan.
It can be made by using a piece of class 3 sacred clay on a creation kiln.
Like all sacred clay items, it can be traded freely between players who are on the same team during the minigame.

The Saradomin statuette is an ancient artefact available as a drop from revenants in the Forinthry Dungeon.

It was originally a drop from players in PvP worlds and Bounty Hunter worlds to replace certain items that were removed from the drop lists in those worlds (such as abyssal whip, dragon full helm, and dragonfire shield).

Satyr Armguards.x: The Satyr Armguards are a hands slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Satyr outfit.

sc: It is given to the player by Lead archaeologist Abigail, and the player must fill it with Scabarite notes before returning it to her.
It can be found in the bookcase of a Player-owned house listed under "My Notes" with a subtitle: "Dealing With Scabaras".
The notes can be found by killing Scabarite creatures.
The player must obtain four different notes for the quest by killing Skeletons, Dried zombies and Scabarites north of the archaeologist camp, or Mummies to the west.
Shoes (female, flats) is obtained from the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion.
Upon receiving a piece from the ringmaster, it becomes available as a cosmetic override in the Customisation interface.
There are four types of shoes which may be awarded to players.
The boots can be purchased from Stanley Limelight Traders for 750 thaler.
Ironmen cannot obtain silverhawk boots.
The snowboard (vorkath) is an item that can be received from the 2025 variant of blue Christmas Present.
Spider carcass is obtained as a drop from jungle spiders.

The carcass can be attached to skewer sticks obtained from cutting thatching spars with a machete and can then be cooked into spiders on stick, which heal for 400 life points and occasionally heal an extra 100 life points.
The standard fragment is an item obtained during the Birthright of the Dwarves quest.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 steel bars, requiring 600 progress to complete, granting a total of 150 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like tiny spiky steel salvage by the spring cleaner.
It is made by adding clean buckthorn and a twisted root to a vial of water.
It can be made by attaching a Fremennik equipment patch to a rock-shell helm.
The superior scrimshaw of attack is an item that can be made within a Player-owned port workshop once all 4 scroll pieces of the scrimshaw have been obtained.

Tribal ringlet (red, female).x: The red tribal ringlet is part of the tribal outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: It can be purchased from Raid Rewards, a shop run by the armoursmith on Mazcab.
Originally this was available from the Tuska Comes world event.
The experience given by each unstable protean shake scales according to the player's Herblore level at certain intervals.

sc: To obtain a white scimitar, a player ranked as a Master White Knight can either buy one from Sir Vyvin or another player.
The Winter Scarf (Aurora) is a neck slot item that can be obtained from the Santa's Grotto promotion on Treasure Hunter from 22 December 2023 to 3 January 2024.
It is found while studying the bull's head upstairs in his house, and is turned into a red disk by using some sticky red goop melted off of a red herring also found there.
The red disk is used on an abstract mural downstairs along with another old red disk in order to obtain a vase lid needed to complete Peer's challenge.
